notes.title: HUGE UPDATE
notes.notes:
New Update Now Live!

Get ready for a smoother, more strategic gameplay experience in our latest update! We’ve listened to your feedback and made some major improvements across multiple aspects of the game. Here's what’s new:

New Precision Shooting Mechanic: Take control of the action with our new click-to-shoot feature! You can now aim directly at enemies by pointing and clicking, and even reduce your cooldown time by clicking faster, letting you unleash a flurry of arrows when it counts. This adds a new layer of strategy, giving you more power over each shot.

Enhanced Tutorial and Level 1 Experience: We’ve added a practical tutorial to the first level, making it easier for new players to jump in and learn the ropes, while keeping it easy and accessible.

Improved Progression and Rewards: Enemy waves spawn more quickly, and now the bigger enemies reward you with more coins. You’ll be able to afford upgrades faster, without needing to replay levels too often.

Balanced Difficulty: We’ve made adjustments to levels and enemy waves so they’re challenging but fair. No more unavoidable game overs – strategic play is now better rewarded, especially with new targeting options to help you control which enemies to attack.

Volume, Music, and Sound Fixes: The volume now starts at an audible level, and we’ve updated the soundtrack to better match the game’s vibe. The music will loop properly, so no more sudden silence mid-game.

Cooldown and Skill Point Improvements: Only the used power will go on cooldown now, allowing for more flexible power usage. Plus, skill points are now clearly introduced, making it easier to upgrade arrows and unlock new abilities.

Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed several bugs, including graphic overlaps, purchase issues, and archer purchase glitches. Everything should now work seamlessly, allowing you to focus on the action.

Whether you’re a returning player or diving in for the first time, we think you’ll love the smoother gameplay, added precision, and improved strategy options in this update. Jump back in and check out the new changes!
